_comment: v2 — CE-legal recipes per canon/crafting.json budgets (C 2-3 CE commons-only; U 6 CE >=1 uncommon card; R 18 CE >=1 rare card). cost.commons = {id:n}; cost.any_commons = n (any commons); cost.any_cards = {tier:n}. Buildings place on your current tile. Blacksmith perk: -1 common (min 1 total).

recipes.name: Cooked Meal
recipes.desc: Care phase: eat for +3 Energy (raw commons give +1).

recipes.name: Stone Axe
recipes.desc: +1 common when gathering on Wood or Stone tiles.

recipes.name: Campfire
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile: cook raw food into Cooked Meals for free.

recipes.name: Offering Bundle
recipes.desc: The Guardians accept this. Spirit is earned, not gathered.

recipes.name: Homebase Camp
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile. Acts as Crafting Bench: unlocks Uncommon+ crafting here.

recipes.name: Wayside Shrine
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile. Sacred pillar: offer 1 common for +1 Light once/turn.

recipes.name: Fish Weir
recipes.desc: Placed on water tile. Water gathers yield +1 extra common.

recipes.name: Storage Cache
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile. Secure depot storing surplus resources.

recipes.name: Workshop
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile. Unlocks Legendary crafting (needs a bench here too).

recipes.name: Stone Forge
recipes.desc: Placed on your tile. Blazing forge: refines metals and tools.
